targetCompanyImage.name: Cambrian Innovation Water Asset SPVs
targetCompanyImage.subsector: Industrial water reuse and wastewater treatment
targetCompanyImage.description: Cambrian Innovation Water Asset SPVs are project vehicles used to finance industrial wastewater treatment, water reuse, and energy recovery infrastructure. Their end users are industrial and food-and-beverage customers that need on-site utility services without funding treatment plants directly. The operating model is asset-heavy and contracted, with projects deployed under service-based arrangements such as Cambrian's Water-Energy Purchase Agreement structure. Public materials describe Cambrian as a provider of wastewater treatment, water reuse, and energy recovery-as-a-service, and third-party case materials note that the company had deployed more than ten industrial plants as the platform scaled. Cambrian announced a $30 million WEPA financing vehicle in November 2015; public reporting identified Generate Capital as lead investor, and Generate's own archive describes a jointly owned Cambrian project-based SPV. The reviewed materials did not disclose SPV-level revenue or current ownership percentages within the Generate-Cambrian financing structures. Cambrian itself was acquired by Pennybacker in 2023 at the corporate level.

milestones.event: Cambrian announced a $30 million WEPA financing vehicle; public reporting later identified Generate Capital as lead investor in the fund.
Cambrian announced a dedicated capital program with project finance partners to support service-based industrial water projects.
Pennybacker announced the acquisition of Cambrian and a US$200 million growth commitment at the corporate level.
Cambrian announced a US$150 million credit facility with ING to support further expansion of its water and energy infrastructure offerings.
